metadata.method: Fresh llvm-objdump address ranges from independently parsed actual Mach-O nlist. Every nonaddress instruction/register/immediate, local branch offset and indirect call register retained; external controls resolve symbol/import identity. ADRP page and consuming add/load offsets normalized together to actual reference identity; ObjC ivar cells include actual int32 offsets, selector refs decode chained rebases to actual selector strings, imports decode actual indirect or dyld bind. No symbol-name/count-only PASS; changed or unresolved instructions remain explicit.
metadata.notes: Function equivalence under ordinary native binding/lifetime contracts only. Names/offset resolution does not by itself establish mutable runtime global contents or global heap equivalence.
